title: FeedbackMessage
description: Data contract emitted by the rules engine (src/feedback/pushup.py) for direct consumption by the mobile client. Field names and enums are aligned to the engine's actual state machine (evaluate_pushup_stream). Fields are exhaustive and non-nullable to avoid ambiguous handling on the client side. NOTE: as of this version, pushup.py returns ONE summary object per evaluated clip rather than one message per frame/transition, and only detects HIP_SAG. See docs/06_feedback/cues_matrix.md §4 'Engine Changes Required' for the gaps this schema exposes.

rep_count.description: Number of completed repetitions. In pushup.py this increments only on the ASCENDING -> PLANK transition (elbow_angle > 150.0 after having passed through BOTTOM), i.e. a full-depth rep.

state.description: Current node of the engine's state machine, exactly as emitted by evaluate_pushup_stream in pushup.py.

is_valid.description: false whenever error_code is not NONE. In the current pushup.py implementation this flag is sticky for the whole evaluated stream (set to false on the first HIP_SAG frame and never reset), so it reports 'was this clip ever invalid', not 'is this exact frame valid'. Per-frame reset is required before this can drive live in-session cues (PRD-EX-001 Phase 3) -- see cues_matrix.md §4.

error_code.description: Single active error. NONE is used instead of null so the client never branches on a missing field. Only HIP_SAG is currently detected by pushup.py; NO_REP_DEPTH is part of this contract per task scope but is not yet set anywhere in the engine (the DESCENDING -> PLANK 'abandoned rep' branch needs it -- see cues_matrix.md §3 and §4). Codes from the wider PRD-EX-001 §5 catalog (HIP_PIKE, PARTIAL_LOCKOUT, OCCLUSION) are intentionally out of scope for this schema version and are not valid values here; adding them is an additive, non-breaking schema change for a later sprint.

cue_text.description: Short, unambiguous corrective or status text for on-screen/audio display, sourced verbatim from docs/06_feedback/cues_matrix.md. Empty string is not permitted -- use "Good form" when is_valid is true and error_code is NONE.
